Name: Mouse Friends in the Forest
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]11 [/size][size=5]Mouse Friends to Join the Hat Mouse[/size][/color][/b]
This mod adds 11 mouse friends doing various activities throughout Cindersap Forest. They will appear after you receive a letter from Hat Mouse about their shop opening. After you first meet all of them. two of them will randomly visit the forest every day, weather permitting.

These mice are based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/79665293]Doragoun[/url]'s adorable [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17364][i]Hat Mouse and Friends[/i][/url]. Be sure to check it out! 

[size=6][b]L[/b][/size][size=5][b]atest Update[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Added Ribbon Mouse, a painter who is visiting the valley! With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14493][i]MEEP[/i][/url] installed, you'd be able to see the paintings she draws.
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/1249127-1768617101.png[/img][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348][i]SpaceCore[/i][/url], you can now buy various charm that can call to a specific mouse you want to appear the next day.
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/1249127-1768617154.png[/img]﻿[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]Added compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12831][i]Dynamic Reflections[/i][/url].
[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/1249127-1768616985.png[/img]﻿[/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]S[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]pecial Mod Interactions[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17364][i]Hat Mouse and Friends[/i][/url] has these same mouse friends randomly attending the hat shop every day. If you have it installed, some of their dialogue will acknowledge their presence at the shop.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19112][i]Secret Woods Snorlax[/i][/url] replaces the log blocking your way to the Secret Woods with Snorlax. With it installed some mice would acknowledge it.[/*]
[*]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073][i]Trinket Tinker[/i][/url] installed—and after fulfilling certain conditions—you'll be able to summon Hatsnatcher Cat, a wicked cat who snatches hat! Hatsnatcher Cat can fight enemies, give you random hats, and has things to say about various mice when you talk near them. It includes those in other mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17315]Fievel[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18177]Lacey[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17348]Cap Mouse[/url].[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/i] installed.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Mouse Friends in the Forest[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mouse Friends in the Forest[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Only works with [i]Stardew Valley[/i] version 1.6 and later.[/*]
[*]Tested working with [b][i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Probably also doesn't conflict with any other mod that alter the layout of Cindersap Forest. Do tell me if it did.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]K[/size][size=5]nown Issues[/size][/color]
[/b]When installed on an existing save file, the mouse friends may exhibit strange behavior on the first day. For example, they might not be interactable or may need to be saved from being stuck on trees and crops. This issue should resolve from the second day onward.

 [b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).
